findings.statement: T.N. Kaul writes that some cussed and overzealous literary critics have wrongly attributed one of Arinimaal's most pathetic ditties, 'åríní rang gom shràvan híyè', to her contemporary Mahmud Gami (1765–1855).

Shashi Shekhar Toshakhani writes that Autar Krishen Rehbar has proved that the basic lines of 'åríní rang gom shràvan híyè' are Arinimaal's only, and that it is the refrain 'åríní rang gom shràvan híyè' that is common in two different poems.

Naji Munawar writes that after going through the manuscripts titled 'Yakh Hakayath' and 'Ponpuri', they can conclude that either Mehmud's era has wrongly been calculated or there has been another poet named Mehmud whose verse has got messed up with that of Mehmud Gaami.
